Visit note | 2025-06-04 10:30 AM | Dr. Nasrin Sultana, Gastroenterology | Patient: Nadia Akand, 58, female. Mrs. Akand returns for review, reporting that her symptoms feel worse when she lies down and she continues to notice a sour taste in her mouth. She works as a beautician and mentions that her discomfort became worse after weeks of eating fried snacks at tea stalls in Bogura. She has no chronic comorbidities. Visit note | 2025-06-04 10:30 AM | Dr. Habibur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Abdul Sikder, 46, male. Mr. Sikder presents with a twisted ankle and sharp pain when walking.
